$comment: The only commands .github/workflows/cloud-test.yml can run. Format: cloud-test/README.md in Colorado-Startups/.github. Paths in pip and artifacts start at the checkout root; cwd sets where before and run start. The self-tests mirror gate-selftests.yml, check:marker-parity mirrors marker-parity.yml, verify:comparison-maps mirrors comparison-map-verify.yml, and the render and vision entries follow 03_deliverables/infographics/BUILD.md.

selftests.$comment: All six gate self-tests, in gate-selftests.yml order, stopping at the first failure. The pull_request default. The log shows every one; the job summary shows the last.

check:marker-parity.$comment: The corridor atlas's four files carry the same 53 markers.

verify:comparison-maps.$comment: Geometry of the Silicon Valley comparison maps. Imports the generator, so it needs matplotlib.

render:infographic.$comment: The launch infographic PDF. Check brand_fonts= True and OVERFLOW none in the job summary.

render:infographic-png.$comment: The PDF, then BUILD.md's rasterize step with pdftoppm from poppler-utils. The build's own lines are in the log, under its group.

render:comparison-maps.$comment: Both comparison maps and their previews.

render:vision.$comment: The vision page, then its --check. Standard library only, so no pip.

check:vision-rebuild.$comment: BUILD.md's reproducibility check: a rebuild must leave the committed page byte for byte unchanged.
